en.title: No Infantino challenger – UEFA President Ceferin stands for re-election
en.summary: Aleksander Ceferin plans to run for a fourth and final term as UEFA president in the coming year.

stories.title: Documents médicaux falsifiés: un chirurgien du CHUV suspendu et dénoncé à la justice

en.title: Falsified medical documents: a CHUV surgeon suspended and reported to justice
en.summary: A surgeon at CHUV was suspended and reported to authorities after internal investigation discovered falsified medical documents in the plastic and reconstructive surgery department.

en.title: Granit Xhaka has been convicted of forged Covid certificates – now discussions with the federation follow
en.summary: The Swiss national team captain Granit Xhaka was sentenced to a conditional fine by prosecutors for forged Covid certificates.

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: At least 33 dead in Russian attack on Kramatorsk +++ Ukrainian drone attacks on Omsk
en.summary: Russia continues its ongoing war against Ukraine with recent developments including a Russian attack on Kramatorsk and Ukrainian drone operations targeting Omsk.

stories.title: «J’ai fait un gros tacle sur Paul Gascoigne»: Ramon Vega, ancien joueur de l’équipe de Suisse et drôle de candidat à la présidence de la FIFA

en.title: "I made a big tackle on Paul Gascoigne": Ramon Vega, former Swiss national team player and odd candidate for FIFA presidency
en.summary: Former Swiss international defender Ramon Vega announced his candidacy for FIFA president in the 2027 election to be held in Rabat, Morocco. The 55-year-old Zurich native, who played 28 times for Switzerland in the 1990s, is now working in finance in London.

stories.title: «On est dans un Tetris permanent»: Genève face au casse-tête d’un canton trop exigu pour ses zones industrielles

en.title: "We're in permanent Tetris": Geneva faces puzzle of canton too small for its industrial zones
en.summary: Geneva's state councillor for economy presented a strategy to strengthen industrial and craft activities. Industrial and craft sectors represent 12% of the canton's GDP, nearly matching the banking sector's 13%.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Machtkampf in der Fifa: Jetzt will der Schweizer Ramon Vega Präsident werden

en.title: LATEST DEVELOPMENTS - Power struggle at FIFA: Swiss Ramon Vega now wants to become president
en.summary: The battle for the FIFA presidency has intensified since the summer 2026 World Cup, with the presidential election scheduled for March. Recent developments and background information are outlined.

stories.title: Dans le canton de Vaud, il faudra travailler un peu plus pour toucher des subsides à l'assurance maladie

en.title: In Vaud canton, one will need to work more to receive health insurance subsidies
en.summary: Vaud canton will require single persons to work at least 80% of full-time hours to qualify for health insurance subsidies, increasing from the current 70% threshold.

stories.title: Bedingte Geldstrafe – Granit Xhaka wegen gefälschtem Covid-Zertifikat verurteilt

en.title: Conditional fine – Granit Xhaka convicted for forged Covid certificate
en.summary: Football player Granit Xhaka has been convicted and received a conditional fine for using a forged Covid certificate. He confirmed the conviction through a statement on his Instagram account.

stories.title: Le Nobel de littérature décerné à la canadienne Anne Carson, écrivaine érudite et subversive

en.title: Nobel Prize in Literature awarded to Canadian Anne Carson, erudite and subversive writer
en.summary: Canadian author Anne Carson has received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her innovative and daring body of work that blends classical mythology with contemporary themes. She currently resides in Iceland.

stories.title: L'autrice canadienne Anne Carson gagne le prix Nobel de littérature

en.title: Canadian author Anne Carson wins the Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature has been awarded to Canadian poet Anne Carson, age 76, for her bold and inventive work, the jury announced on Thursday.

en.title: War in Ukraine – Governor: At least 30 dead in Russian attack on bus
en.summary: A Russian attack on a bus in Kramatorsk in eastern Ukraine has resulted in at least 30 deaths according to local authorities.

stories.title: Die deutsche Wirtschaft wächst stärker als erwartet. Es gibt aber ein Problem

en.title: German economy grows stronger than expected. But there is a problem
en.summary: Germany's government projects 2026 GDP growth of 1.3 percent, more than double its previous forecast. Business associations nonetheless demand that promised economic reforms be implemented.

stories.title: Die reichen Teens und Twens der Generation Z geben doppelt so viel Geld für Kunst aus wie ältere Generationen

en.title: Wealthy Generation Z teens and young adults spend twice as much money on art as older generations
en.summary: Young affluent members of Generation Z purchase significantly more art than their older counterparts. Family connections serve as the primary gateway into the art market, according to research by Arts Economics and UBS.

stories.title: Die deutsche Bundeswehr wäre im Drohnenkrieg nicht auf der Höhe der Zeit. So will sie von der Ukraine lernen

en.title: German Bundeswehr would not be up to date in drone warfare. This is how it wants to learn from Ukraine
en.summary: Drone use significantly reshapes modern military operations. Germany aims to close its capability gap by having an entire military unit test new drone systems.

stories.title: Donald Trump nutzte Steuergelder für Eigenwerbung. Jetzt krebst er zurück, aber die Kontroverse läuft weiter

en.title: Donald Trump used taxpayer money for self-promotion. Now he is backing down, but the controversy continues
en.summary: Advertising films were intended to show Americans the country's successes under Trump. However, the controversy over the president initially charging campaign costs to taxpayers threatens to overshadow this message.

stories.title: Überall leere Kassen: China hat die Jagd auf die Reichen des Landes freigegeben

en.title: Empty coffers everywhere: China has unleashed the hunt for the country's wealthy
en.summary: As state revenues decline, China's government is targeting wealthy citizens through legal and questionable methods, causing unrest among millionaires.
